info.name: Food API
info.description:
# Food API

A RESTful API for a **food ordering platform** that enables users to browse restaurants and menus, manage their cart, place orders, and leave reviews. The API also provides dedicated interfaces for restaurant administrators to manage their listings and orders, as well as a super admin panel for platform-wide oversight.

**Base URL:** `http://localhost:8080/api`

---

## Resource Domains

- **Auth** — User registration and login for all roles (User, Restaurant Admin, Super Admin)
- **Restaurants** — Browse all restaurants or view details; restaurant admins can create, edit, and delete their own listings
- **Menus** — Browse menus across all restaurants or for a specific restaurant; restaurant admins can manage their menu items
- **Cart** — Users can create and manage carts, add/edit/remove items, and proceed to checkout
- **Orders** — Users can view, pay, and cancel orders; restaurant admins can process and mark orders as delivered
- **Reviews** — Users can create, edit, and delete reviews; public access to view restaurant reviews
- **Super Admin** — Platform-level access to manage all users and orders

---

## Role-Based Access

| Role | Access Level |
|---|---|
| **Public** | Browse restaurants, menus, and reviews; register and log in |
| **User** | Manage cart, place and track orders, write reviews |
| **Restaurant Admin** | Manage owned restaurants, menus, and incoming orders |
| **Super Admin** | Full platform oversight — users, orders, and order details |

---

## Getting Started

1. Use the **Auth > Public** endpoints to register or log in with the appropriate role.
2. Authenticate your requests using the token returned from the login response.
3. Explore the relevant folder for your role to interact with the API.

item.description:
Contains all restaurant-related endpoints, organized into two sub-folders based on access level:

- **Public** – Read-only endpoints available to all users. Allows browsing the full list of restaurants and retrieving the details of a specific restaurant.
    
- **Restaurant Admin** – Protected endpoints restricted to restaurant owners. Covers the full lifecycle of restaurant management: creating a new restaurant, retrieving owned restaurants, updating restaurant details, and deleting a restaurant.

item.description:
Contains all menu-related endpoints, organized into two sub-folders based on access level:

- **Public** – Read-only endpoints available to all users. Allows browsing the full list of menus across all restaurants, retrieving menus from a specific restaurant, and viewing the details of an individual menu item.
- **Restaurant Admin** – Write endpoints restricted to restaurant owners/admins. Covers the full lifecycle of menu management: creating a new menu item for a restaurant, updating an existing item, and deleting one.

item.description:
Contains all order-related endpoints, organized into two sub-folders based on user role:

- **User** – Endpoints available to authenticated customers. Allows users to view their order list, retrieve order details, make a payment, and cancel an order.
- **Restaurant Admin** – Endpoints restricted to restaurant owners/admins. Allows admins to view incoming orders, retrieve order details, and update order statuses by processing or marking them as delivered.

All endpoints require authentication and interact with the `/api/orders` and `/api/resto-orders` routes.
